title: NMSDC Annual Conference & Exchange 2026
subtitle: A certified MBE partner for enterprise Salesforce, Cloud, Data and AI delivery
excerpt: Procyon, a certified minority business enterprise, is attending the 2026 NMSDC Annual Conference & Exchange in Los Angeles to connect with corporate buyers and supplier-diversity leaders seeking a proven enterprise technology partner.
description:
The NMSDC Annual Conference & Exchange is the country's premier forum connecting certified minority business enterprises with the corporations that want to buy from them. Procyon Technostructure is a certified MBE, and we are attending to meet the supplier-diversity and procurement leaders who need enterprise technology delivered without compromise.

For more than 20 years, Procyon has delivered enterprise transformation across Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Cloud, Data, and AI for 75+ global clients and 200+ projects, backed by three global delivery centers and ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified delivery. Partnering with Procyon lets corporations advance their supplier-diversity commitments while working with a team that delivers at enterprise scale.

In Los Angeles, we want to meet corporate buyers, Tier 1 prime contractors, and supplier-diversity program leaders exploring diverse technology partners for Salesforce and Agentforce, cloud and data modernization, enterprise integration, and managed services. Let us talk about where a certified MBE partner can strengthen both your delivery outcomes and your supplier-diversity goals.
highlights: Certified MBE with 20+ years of enterprise delivery
Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Cloud, Data and AI under one partner
3 global delivery centers with a senior US and offshore blend
ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified delivery
A partner that advances your supplier-diversity goals
